zoe: Tiny travel thread for the Prague meetup 1f3f01f01f7
Q1: snack swap at dinner? bring a couple local treats to trade? Q2: adapters 4bb50c universal or buy at airport?
matt: Snacks yes. Smaller items only so people can bring back. Mini chocolate/preserved fruit = winners.
elaine: Adapter: bring a small universal. Airport shops sell them but often pricier. Also bring a short extension cord if hotel outlets weird.
chun: Pro tip: label chargers with a bit of colored tape. Helps at shared tables.
travel-bot: Poll: "Snack swap tonight?" Results: 3 yes, 0 no.
zoe: OK snack swap 8pm outside hotel lobby. I'll bring a box and sticky notes for allergies. See you there! :tada:
